concept.name: Mad Mex
concept.tagline: Mexican takeout and casual dining on South Highland Ave, Pit

menu.name: Chicken Burrito
menu.description: Flour tortilla filled with grilled chicken, rice, black beans, cheese, and salsa.
menu.imagePrompt: A foil-wrapped chicken burrito cut in half on a takeout paper tray, rice and cheese visible, warm lighting, no text, no people.

menu.name: Beef Burrito
menu.description: Flour tortilla stuffed with seasoned ground beef, rice, beans, cheese, and pico de gallo.
menu.imagePrompt: A wrapped beef burrito in a takeout container with pico de gallo on the side, no text, no people.

menu.name: Beef Tacos (3)
menu.description: Three soft corn tortillas with seasoned beef, onion, cilantro, and lime.
menu.imagePrompt: Three soft corn tacos with cilantro and lime wedges in a cardboard takeout box, no text, no people.

menu.name: Chicken Quesadilla
menu.description: Grilled flour tortilla with melted cheese and seasoned chicken, served with sour cream and salsa.
menu.imagePrompt: A golden grilled quesadilla cut into wedges with sour cream and salsa cups, no text, no people.

menu.name: Chicken Enchiladas (2)
menu.description: Two rolled tortillas topped with red sauce and melted cheese, served with rice and beans.
menu.imagePrompt: Two enchiladas under red sauce and melted cheese with rice and beans in a takeout tray, no text, no people.

menu.name: Nachos Supreme
menu.description: Tortilla chips topped with melted cheese, beans, jalapenos, sour cream, and guacamole.
menu.imagePrompt: A loaded plate of tortilla chips with melted cheese, jalapenos, and guacamole in a takeout box, no text, no people.

menu.name: Horchata
menu.description: Cold cinnamon rice drink served over ice.
menu.imagePrompt: A tall cup of horchata with ice and a cinnamon stick on a takeout carrier, no text, no people.

brand.logoPrompt: A flat two-color mark pairing a simple chili pepper outline with bold sans-serif letters spelling MAD MEX, red on cream.
brand.voice: Friendly and straightforward, talking to customers like neighbors who want a good, filling meal without fuss.
